beats.text: Five habits of people who stay calm when everyone else is spiralling.
One. They respond instead of react. There's a pause between the trigger and the reply.
Two. They don't argue with reality. They deal with what is, not what should have been.
Three. They fiercely protect their sleep and their mornings. Calm is built before the day starts.
Four. They let small things stay small, and refuse to rehearse every minor annoyance.
Five. They know exactly what they can't control — and they put it down, on purpose.
Calm isn't a personality you're born with. It's a set of small choices, repeated.
